regions.label: Right lateral entorhinal cortex (aimed at Right PER)
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right lateral entorhinal cortex, not Right PER. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.
